cohort: Women with severe preeclampsia (PET group, n = 17) and healthy normotensive pregnant women with a singleton pregnancy at term (control group, n = 62).
finding: The NICaS™ device noninvasively demonstrated low CO and high TPR profiles in the PET group compared to controls.
mod_finding: This study on hemodynamic changes in women with severe preeclampsia compared to healthy pregnant women focused exclusively on cesarean section deliveries.
